name: Kenco Kerry Group DC - Calhoun GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open-access campus. The south driveway off Clarence King Drive is an unrestricted paved intersection with no barrier arm or gate; 2024-02 Street View shows only traffic cones. No perimeter fence anywhere along Clarence King Drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at any entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West building (315 Clarence King Dr / Union Grove Logistics Center Bldg 1, 720k SF) has a long dock bank along its west face facing the road; Street View shows ~50+ doors with trailers backed in. Combined with the adjacent east building's dock bank the campus exceeds 50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large angled-row trailer drop yard at the north end of the campus holds 50+ trailers, separate from the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Union Grove Logistics Center is a two-building campus (Bldg 1 west + a larger building to the east) plus additional warehouses to the NW; classified as a campus.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide dock apron between Clarence King Drive and the dock doors plus the north yard provide internal queue/staging room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Calhoun industrial park along I-75, surrounded by woods and scattered rural residential; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; the I-75 corridor is adjacent but no siding.

citations.claim: Kenco operates Kerry's 468,000 SF North Georgia DC in Calhoun GA, serving Kerry's Calhoun and Rome GA facilities
Active Kenco Logistics warehouse requisitions in Calhoun GA as of April 2026

verification.rationale: Kenco-operated dedicated DC for Kerry Group (opened Jan 2023); active 2026 Kenco hiring in Calhoun; no closure/contract-loss found.
